scope: Colour bitmap sampling before palette assignment; direct SVG and monochrome paths preserved. Graphic detail threshold 0.01 mm2 is not sewability.

methodology.fidelity: Source SVG-derived rasters, immutable source hashes, separate fg4/bg8 topology and literal paints observed before tracing. Native tracing checked independently by existing resvg audit. Single corpus trials include oracle snapshots and are excluded from timing estimates.
methodology.performance: Preparation-only in isolated subprocesses; one warm-up plus seven measured iterations; no corpus oracle snapshots in timing runs. p95 is an empirical percentile from seven observations, not a tail guarantee. Whole-process macOS ru_maxrss in bytes, converted to MiB, includes imports and native libraries. Development machine load was not controlled; these observations are not proof of a performance improvement.
methodology.machine: Seven source/frozen interpreted-SVG pairs and PES/DST bytes decoded and compared; physical safety audits retained. Two recoverable 0.5 mm violet controls compare native SVG, old bitmap and new bitmap. No sewn output certified.

stress.note: macOS ru_maxrss bytes, complete process and imports; random opaque RGB is photo-like colour complexity, not semantic photography.
macOS ru_maxrss bytes, complete process and imports; random opaque RGB is photo-like colour complexity, not semantic photography.

limits: RGB-antialiased or compressed sources exceeding max_colors have alpha-only source auditing; this does not certify preservation of their small colour accents. Four 0.25/0.5 mm antialiased circular violet controls remain absent after palette assignment.
The existing 58 omitted Union Jack regions remain; no stitch planner or alpha-matting change is claimed.
The 2048-pixel sampling side cap and 16MP source cap bound work; details beyond that resolution are reported, not reconstructed.
Native graphic preservation does not guarantee physical coverage or sewout quality on fabric.

environment.load_note: Development environment. Concurrent test/build/server activity was possible and not controlled. Each case used an isolated subprocess, but the machine was not reserved exclusively. Descriptive timing observations, no claimed speedup.

controls.stitch_params: Same stable-fabric, 40 wt, cutaway, PP1, balanced auto, density100%, six-colour settings as seven reference cases.

reproduction.status: No scripts/benchmark_sampling.py added. The proof drivers, source snapshots and user-image copies are retained under ignored output/engine-consolidation/. Local replay commands require these existing ignored artifacts. Critical synthetic regressions are portable in tracked tests.
